caption: One eye ray for one pixel meets the sphere twice: t = 4 on the near side and t = 6 on the far side, and only the near hit at (0,0,−4) is kept. From that hit, a shadow ray, a reflected ray that recurses with depth reduced by one, and a refracted ray (glass only) are weighted by k_r and k_t and added to the local colour.

spec.title: One eye ray, worked example
spec.aria: One eye ray is tested against all three objects, keeps the near sphere hit at t = 4 and rejects the far root t = 6, then sends out a shadow ray, a reflected ray with depth reduced by one and a refracted ray, whose weighted colours are combined into the pixel colour.
